meta.name: observability-baseline
meta.description: Set minimum observability with structured logs, correlation IDs, and baseline metrics for latency/errors/throughput. Use when adding services or stabilizing operations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为服务添加结构化日志、关联ID和基础监控指标
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在服务中快速建立可观测性基础
copy.tagline_en: Add structured logs, correlation IDs, and baseline metrics to services
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly establish observability baseline in services

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会为你的服务添加结构化日志、关联ID和基础指标（延迟、错误、吞吐量），确保无需临时打印就能调试。
howto.when: 当你添加新服务或需要稳定运维时，Claude 会读取协议文件并收集仓库证据后生成所需产出。

say.text: 帮我给这个新服务加上结构化日志和关联ID。
say.note: Claude 会按技能流程生成日志字段和指标。

say.text: 检查一下这个服务的延迟和错误率基线。
say.note: Claude 会追踪请求路径并确认关联ID连续性。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude adds structured logs, correlation IDs, and baseline metrics (latency, errors, throughput) to your service, enabling debugging without ad-hoc prints.
howto.when_en: When you add a new service or need to stabilize operations, Claude reads protocol files, collects repository evidence, and produces the required artifact.

say_en.text: Add structured logs and correlation IDs to this new service.
say_en.note: Claude will generate logging fields and metrics per skill workflow.

say_en.text: Check the latency and error rate baseline for this service.
say_en.note: Claude will trace a request path and confirm correlation ID continuity.
